versions.content: Preparation Levels RptImplPolicy . rptPrepara- tionLevel supports three preparation levels: • Level 1 – If RptImplPolicy . rptPreparationLevel is set to rptLevel1 then the generated RTE uses a specific memory access pattern (a write-read cycle within accessing code created by the RTE generator) suitable for access by post-build hooking tools patch writes to buffers. • Level 2 – If RptImplPolicy . rptPreparationLevel is set to rptLevel2 then in addition to the use of an RP global buffer (as for rptLevel1 ) the gen- erated code also includes an RP enabler flag that is used to make update of the RP global buffer conditional. The RP enabler flag can be in either (calibratable) ROM or RAM based on Rpt- Container . rptEnablerImplType . • Level 3 – If RptImplPolicy . rptPreparationLevel is set to rptLevel3 then in addition to the requirements of rptLevel2 , the generated code also records the original ECU-generated value as well as the RP replacement value.
